versions.name: Muskingum Valley Scout Reservation

features.note: Opening and closing campfires are held at the Council Ring.
Shower houses in both North Camp and South Camp.
An interfaith service is held at the camp chapel each week.
A Counselor-in-Training program for Scouts aged 14 and older.
A climbing tower, with night climbs offered by sign-up.
A low COPE course.
Open to Scouts aged 14 and older with a signed permission form.
Cafeteria-style service with a salad bar.
The Netami program for first-year campers: a fully scheduled day introducing every area of camp.
Fishing on the camp lake, with Complete Angler and Big Fish awards.
A gaga ball pit by the trading post.
PEAK, an unstructured high-adventure track for Scouts aged 14 and older.
Eco-Con keeps live animals in an observation cabin.
Eco-Con, the ecology and conservation area, with a marked nature trail.
PEAK is limited to Scouts aged 14 and older and interested adult leaders.
Stand-up paddleboarding on the lake, with equipment provided.
A pistol program limited to six participants per week.
Rappelling runs alongside climbing under Level 1 instructors.
Snorkeling award with equipment provided.
Straker Lodge is wired for STEM work and holds a 3D printer.
A private lake used for boating, with rowing, canoeing, and kayaking.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA and Cub Scout resident summer camp in Coshocton, Ohio, operated by the Muskingum Valley Council.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
